LanguageData.KiiroSchizonepetaGum_HealMissingPartsDes: When enabled, gum effect will restore missing body part.
LanguageData.KiiroSchizonepetaGum_VisualEffectDesc: Shows healing effects around pawns chewing gum. Disable to save performance.
LanguageData.KiiroSchizonepetaGum_SoundEffectDesc: Periodically plays a sound effect while chewing gum.
LanguageData.KiiroSchizonepetaGum_SoundVolumeDesc: Adjusts the volume of the chewing gum sound effect. Well, do you want to hear it more clearly?
LanguageData.KiiroSchizonepetaGum_OutlineDesc: Draws an outer outline around pawns chewing gum. Disable to save performance.
LanguageData.KiiroSchizonepetaGum_OutlineWidthDesc: Adjusts the width of the outline.
LanguageData.KiiroSchizonepetaGum_OutlineColorDesc: Click a color swatch to change the outline color.
